mathematical_delta.algorithm: Strict rational endpoint order/width validation, then rational midpoint nearest-grid rounding by computable Rat FloorRing; m is integer floor(midpoint*2^b+1/2), angle is rational m/2^b. No Real floor or exact-real evaluator computes the output.
mathematical_delta.scalar_error: A successful return and lo<=theta<=hi imply absolute error<=2^-b. Midpoint uncertainty and nearest rounding each contribute at most 2^(-b-1).
mathematical_delta.termination: Finite rational operations and structurally recursive list traversal. No search for a unique exact-real floor bin; intervals crossing boundaries are valid inputs and terminate.
mathematical_delta.actual_return_signature: Given actual GlobalAssembly full input, finite interval arity and validity at logarithmic bitsFor, and explicitly INTERNAL real-angle interval Sound, returns existence of an actual Some circuit with identical full Resource, identical chronological constructor/wire/non-RY list after erasing RY payload only, and full Euclidean Hermite target error<=epsilon. Successful return is obtained internally, not assumed in this combined root.
mathematical_delta.allocation: A=24*(n+1)*(2*k+6)^3; b=Nat.clog 2 (max 1 (Nat.ceil (A/epsilon))); epsilon>0. Reuses frozen bitsFor_error; no inefficient linear default.
mathematical_delta.resources: supplyCircuit_resource and supplyCircuit_length hold for every successful return, without Sound. Full Resource includes one/two-qubit counts and wire depth. Exact source gate-count polynomial and literal source target are reused.
mathematical_delta.chronology: supplyCircuit_chronology erases only RY angle payloads. It preserves each constructor, chronological position, ordered physical wire arguments, and the full non-RY instruction including any RZ angle. This is not inferred merely from footprint equality.
mathematical_delta.alignment: supplyCircuit_aligned constructs Forall2 GateAligned from scalar success and Sound; callers supply no alignment or uniform perturbation theorem.
mathematical_delta.target: Same signed normalized literal Hermite target, little-endian data and zero terminal bond, including every garbage coordinate. No conditional amplitude or postselection substitute.
mathematical_delta.ideal_floor_identity: Not required or claimed. The approximation can differ from cycle10 exact-real floor while meeting the same scientific error target.
